{{Top|leg}}
The '''thykar''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Conifer/Legends|conifer]] that grew on the northern continents of [[Carest 1]]. The [[Tree/Legends|trees]] could grow up to 150 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall,<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> and were home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Jiivahar]] species. The thykar [[Forest/Legends|forests]] became a tourist attraction across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
